program_main_gate_restated: the pickup MAIN gate requires >= 20 utility/day versus cond_hist with a paired CI lower bound > 0, plus a positive mean versus the same-initial-value reconstruction-only control. This pilot has no cond_hist arm and few states, so it cannot address the main gate.
what_this_measures: whether the guide-scored reconstruction differs from the distance-only reconstruction on identical states, masks, seeds and decoder calls
what_this_does_not_measure: no cond_hist arm, no strong rolling controller, no acceptance policy over a day
few engineered states: every interval is DESCRIPTIVE, carries no alpha, and cannot support a stable-online-gain, attribution, impossibility or equivalence claim
the >= 20 utility/day main gate is NOT addressed by this pilot
